objects.description: During the [Unitronics Defacement Campaign](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0031), the [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) defaced controllers’ [Human-Machine Interface (HMI)](https://attack.mitre.org/assets/A0002), which prevented multiple entities from being able to operate their devices normally.(Citation: CISA AA23-335A IRGC-Affiliated December 2023)(Citation: CISA Unitronics November 2023)(Citation: Jamie Tarabay and Katrina Manson December 2023)(Citation: Frank Bajak and Marc Levy December 2023) Additionally, the [CyberAv3ngers](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1027) caused a communications failure in a remote pumping station.(Citation: WPXI Aliquippa Water November 2023)
